title: Aevum Protocol
tagline: Cryptographic proof your trading strategy ran honestly — live on Ethereum Mainnet.
description:
Aevum Protocol's Verifiable Backtest Oracle (VBO) solves the credibility problem in algorithmic trading. Anyone can show a great backtest there's no way to know if it was cherry-picked after the fact. VBO makes that impossible.

Traders commit a cryptographic hash of their strategy on-chain before the forward test window opens. Atlas Oracle cryptographically signs the BTC/USD price at both commit and attestation time using data from 905+ exchange sources. When the window closes, traders submit their logs and Aevum attests the results on-chain. The result is a permanent certificate proving the strategy ran honestly with zero look-ahead bias, independently verified benchmark prices, and no way to fake the timing.

Live on Ethereum Mainnet since September 3, 2026. First mainnet commitment active. 4 contracts deployed and verified on Etherscan.
how_its_made:
VBO v2 inherits Atlas Oracle's PullOracleConsumerStandard, making it the first trading strategy certification system with cryptographically signed benchmark prices. The architecture has 4 layers:

Smart contracts AgentIdentity, ReputationOracle v2, ReputationController v2, and VBO v2 deployed on Ethereum Mainnet. VBO v2 uses Atlas Oracle pull-mode price feeds (BTC/USD feed #626, 905+ exchange sources, ConsensusScore verified).
Serverless Atlas integration a Vercel serverless function fetches the Atlas signed price payload server-side and builds the VBO calldata before sending to MetaMask. This solves the Atlas payload requirement without exposing API keys in the browser.
Frontend React/Vite on Vercel with WalletConnect via Reown AppKit. Agent registration gate checks on-chain identity before allowing strategy commits. Certificate page displays Atlas-verified BTC/USD prices with ATLAS VERIFIED badge.
Infrastructure Supabase for commitment tracking, Resend for transactional emails, Stripe for payment processing, ImprovMX for email routing.

Two audits completed by Claude Opus 5 — 4 Critical, 6 High, 10 Medium, 8 Low findings all resolved. 36 Foundry tests passing. Hexens professional audit scoped, restarts at first investment close. Partner technology Atlas Oracle:
VBO v2 inherits PullOracleConsumerStandard from Atlas Oracle. This was the critical technical breakthrough without Atlas, BTC/USD benchmark prices on certificates would be self-reported. With Atlas, they are cryptographically signed by 905+ exchange sources and verified on-chain inside the smart contract. The atlasVerified flag on every Certificate struct proves both price points came from Atlas.
auto_summary: An Ethereum protocol that commits trading strategy hashes on-chain and issues attestable backtest certificates using Atlas-signed BTC/USD prices.
